I haven't run anything yet. This is a permanent production delete, and I need two things from you first.

**What the delete is.** The code has `DELETE /api/users/:slug` (`src/user/user.controller.ts:37-40`). It calls `UserService.delete(email)`, which runs `userRepository.delete({ email })` (`src/user/user.service.ts:83-85`). That is a hard delete with no soft-delete flag, so the row can't be restored. `.claude/knowledge/auth.md:47-48` says the endpoint needs no token. I haven't checked whether deleting the user also removes their articles, comments or follows.

**What I need from you:**
1. **The production base URL.** Nothing in the repo names it, so I won't guess a host. I also have no production credentials or database access here.
2. **Confirmation of the exact action.** I'd send `DELETE <prod-base>/api/users/test@example.com` and report the response. Please confirm that's the delete you mean, and that `test@example.com` is a throwaway account and not a real user.

If you'd rather I back it up first, I can fetch `GET /api/user` or the profile for that account before deleting. That only works if you give me a login for it.

• Draft-only for anything outward (comments, messages); confirm before anything destructive or production-facing; never report an action as done that you did not perform.

• Check CURRENT_FOCUS.md for what's actually in-flight.

• Refinement visibility: begin any substantive request with one line — "**Refined prompt:** <the request restated precisely: goal, the stance you're answering from, the constraints that bind it, and the shape of the answer>" — before proceeding. Skip it only for confirmations, continuations, and genuinely trivial replies. Add "· Assumptions: <…>" only when you actually made one.
• Hold whatever bar <prompt_preparation> sets in the actual work, not just in that opening line — and never narrate the block back to me or list which of its sections applied.
</standing_rules>
